title: About Me
content:
Hey there, I'm Dat Nguyen! 🧑‍💻

I am a software engineer passionate about building scalable, efficient systems and exploring modern microservice architectures.

🚀 What I Do

  • Backend Architecture: Building microservices using Node.js, Express, and Docker.
  • Frontend Development: Crafting responsive, fast UI applications with JavaScript & Vite.
  • Continuous Learning: Experimenting with single page application routers, API gateways, and distributed systems.

🎮 Beyond Coding

When I'm not writing code, you can find me reading sci-fi and tech books or playing Don't Starve.
